description: Source code for a wizard in an Odoo (OpenERP) module handling partial stock picking operations, including packing, splitting, and backorder management.

classes.name: partial_picking
classes.description: Wizard class managing partial stock picking operations with states for initialization, splitting, and finalization.

methods.name: make_default
methods.description: Creates a default value function for form fields.

methods.name: _to_xml
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for XML.

methods.name: _get_moves

methods.name: _do_split
methods.description: Splits stock moves into new pickings based on specified quantities, updating prices if needed.

methods.name: _get_default
methods.description: Sets default notification message for back orders.
